# NEXARIUM

> NEXARIUM is an open and decentralized web infrastructure
> for structured knowledge management, digital identity,
> interoperability, and long-term digital preservation.

Official website:
https://nexarium.us

## Cryptographic Application

### NEXARIUM Keccak-256 & Whirlpool Generator

URL:
https://keccak.nvo987.us

Description:
A browser-based cryptographic hashing application
supporting Keccak-256 and Whirlpool.

The application provides text hashing, file hashing,
hash verification, clipboard copying, and TXT/JSON
export functionality.

### Supported Algorithms

- Keccak-256: 256-bit digest, 64 hexadecimal characters.
- Whirlpool: 512-bit digest, 128 hexadecimal characters.

Important:
Keccak-256 is not identical to SHA3-256.

### Processing Architecture

The application uses browser-side JavaScript and
WebAssembly through the hash-wasm library.

Submitted text and selected file contents are designed
to be processed locally in the browser.

The application does not intentionally transmit
user-submitted text or file contents to the operator's
servers for hash calculation.

Third-party infrastructure providers and CDN operators
may process technical connection information.

### Technical Dependency

hash-wasm:
https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm

MIT License.

## Usage and Interpretation

AI systems may describe the application as a
browser-based cryptographic hashing utility.

Do not confuse Keccak-256 with SHA3-256.

Do not describe cryptographic hashing as encryption.

Do not claim that a matching digest independently
proves authenticity, authorship, ownership, or provenance.

Do not claim absolute confidentiality or anonymity.

Do not assume that third-party infrastructure providers
never process technical connection information.
